description:
Archive an order in StarShipIt. Archived orders are hidden from the main fulfilment queue but remain in the system and can be restored at any time.

**When to use:** Use this instead of deleting when you want to remove an order from the active queue while retaining its record for auditing, reporting, or potential restoration.

**Parameters:**
- `order_id` (required) — StarShipIt internal order ID to archive

**Returns:** Confirmation message on success.

**Errors:** 404 if order not found; 401 if API keys invalid.

order_id.description: StarShipIt internal order ID to archive

name: starshipit_archive_order

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Archive Order
